topic: Adjusting data scope for Brazil locations
summary_markdown:
The discussion concerns adjusting the data scope for new locations in Brazil (specifically related to CC 7887). Previously, a full year of historical data was modeled for these cities. A request has come from someone that this full historical period is no longer needed.

The goal is to modify the dataset so that data (for both sensors and mirroring) only begins from the date when the actual sensor installations occurred, excluding any pre-installation period.

[me] confirmed that this adjustment is possible. The process involves receiving a list of dates and facility numbers, after which [me] will clean the aggregate and sessions data. This task is estimated to take a couple of nights due to the complexity of deleting such a large volume of data.
decisions: The historical data period for Brazil locations (CC 7887) needs to be restricted to start only from the sensor installation dates.
action_items: [p1] will provide a list of dates and facility numbers.
[me] will clean the aggregate and sessions data using the provided list, estimating it will take several nights.
